text.en:
The President of the Philippines is authorized and empowered to enter on behalf of the
Commonwealth of the Philippines into any agreement or agreements with the Atlantic, Gulf & Pacific
Company, a corporation duly organized and doing business under the laws of the Philippines, as may be
necessary to supplement and amend the original agreement entered into pursuant to Act Numbered Three
thousand and fifty-six, in order to make the work therein contemplated conform to the changes recommended
by the Director of Public Works and approved by the Secretary of Public Works and Communications, under
such terms and conditions as may be agreed upon by both parties; and upon completion of the work to execute
for the Government of the Commonwealth, as successor of the Government of the Philippine Islands, all
documents and deeds called for by said Act Numbered Three thousand and fifty-six which under said Act
would be executed by the Governor-General of the Philippine Islands.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 9, 1938.
